source_text: Idque umbrosum, utpote non aridum, sed fructuosum memorat et tamquam densitate boni operis nemorosum. Sed haec sponsa dicit, anima dumtaxat, quae columbae iam oculos habet. Hi vero, qui tantummodo credunt sponso, non tamen perspicere potuerunt, in Verbo Dei quanta sit pulchritudo, dicunt: Et vidimus, et non habebat speciem.
pass_a_gloss: And-that shaded, as-being not dry, but fruitful she-recalls and as-if with-density of-good work wooded. But these bride says, soul at-least, which of-dove already eyes has...
pass_b_english: And she recalls it as shaded — not dry, but fruitful and as if wooded with the density of good work. But the Bride says these things — at least the soul that already has dove-eyes. Those who only believe the Bridegroom, yet could not perceive how great is the beauty in God’s Word, say: [[We saw him, and he had no form >> Bible:Isaiah 53:2]].
